title: Super Mario RPG
description:
Team up with an oddball group of heroes to save Star Road and stop the troublemaking Smithy Gang. This colorful RPG has updated graphics and cinematics that add even more charm to the unexpected alliance between Mario, Bowser, Peach, and original characters Mallow and Geno. Enter (or revisit) this world of eccentric allies and offbeat enemies in an RPG for everyone.

Jump through a colorful world and give attacks some extra oomph in battle!

Explore the vibrant environments with your party and jump towards your next goal! Run into monsters to enter turn-based battles with your party of three. Press the button at the right time for a satisfying dose of extra damage or helpful guard.

gameplayPillars.title: Action Commands
gameplayPillars.description: Time button presses to deal extra damage or guard effectively in battle.

gameplayPillars.title: Chain and Triple Moves
gameplayPillars.description: Use Action Commands to build gauge and unleash powerful Chain and Triple Moves.

gameplayPillars.title: Exploration and boss battles
gameplayPillars.description: Explore colorful areas, complete mini-games, and take on memorable bosses across the world.

gameplayPillars.title: Timed defense and party rhythm
gameplayPillars.description: Action Commands are used on offense and defense, keeping battles active and rewarding good timing rather than purely menu-based play.

gameplayPillars.title: Secrets, minigames, and side content
gameplayPillars.description: The adventure includes hidden chests, optional bosses, minigames, and post-story challenges that add more to do beyond the critical path.

worldSummary: Super Mario RPG delivers a whimsical quest through a colorful world full of towns, dungeons, mini-games, expressive characters, and classic turn-based battles with modern presentation upgrades.

storyChapters.title: Repair Star Road
storyChapters.body: Mario sets out to restore wishes after Star Road is disrupted.

storyChapters.title: Gather unlikely allies
storyChapters.body: Peach, Bowser, Mallow, and Geno each bring distinct abilities and personalities to the party.

storyChapters.title: Defeat the Smithy Gang
storyChapters.body: The adventure culminates in battles against the Smithy Gang and its leaders.

storyChapters.title: Meet Geno, Mallow, and unexpected allies
storyChapters.body: Mario gradually builds a memorable party whose personalities, abilities, and interactions carry much of the game's charm and humor.

storyChapters.title: Optional challenges after the finale
storyChapters.body: Even after the main story, players can tackle stronger rematch content, finish side objectives, and hunt down missed treasures and secrets.

faq.a: No. This remake is a single-player RPG.
Yes. Nintendo lists it as Supported – game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch.

faq.q: What is new in the remake?
faq.a: The Switch version adds remastered visuals, new CGI cutscenes, the Chain and Triple Move battle systems, Breezy mode, and the option to use a remastered or classic soundtrack.

faq.q: How long is Super Mario RPG?
faq.a: The main story is relatively approachable in length, while side content, optional bosses, and completion goals extend the overall playtime meaningfully.

faq.q: Is the remake faithful to the original?
faq.a: Yes. It preserves the core structure, characters, and battle flow of the SNES classic while updating visuals, audio, accessibility, and battle conveniences.

verdictPros: Charming remake of a beloved classic
Excellent pacing and approachable RPG mechanics
Great music options and polished presentation
Action Command timing keeps battles engaging
Optional secrets give the short adventure extra replay value
verdictCons: Low challenge for genre veterans outside selected encounters
Limited postgame compared with larger modern RPGs
Veteran RPG players may outgrow its simple systems quickly
The compact runtime may leave some players wanting a bigger adventure
